subject: reasoning
question:
Six letters A, B, C, P, Q and R are written on different faces of a dice. Two positions of this dice are shown in the figure. Find the letter on the face opposite to C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/493784a165eefd65e9fadc5fad28762d3c2d4e23407c82642ed4c530090b8dad.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given two different cubes the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As R is common on both the dice, it is clear that C, P, A, and B are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e., Q will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9be6bfb65e9ee26f188bb5239af62b74040502d69199bb03ac252353b0da18d5.png] 

Opposite pairs:

A → C

P → B

R → Q

So, the opposite side of "C" will be side "A".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
